worldcombat.skill.razorleaf.summary: Launch wave after wave of sharp leaves down one narrow lane in a chosen direction, each curtain really advancing to shred foes lined up in it; a foe stepping sideways can leave the lane before a later wave. Very short wind-up, several beats, high critical chance. Broad form lays a wider lane with heavier waves but one fewer; dense form chains one more wave down a narrower lane.
worldcombat.skill.razorleaf.use.0: Fire wave after wave of leaves down a single narrow lane
worldcombat.skill.razorleaf.use.1: Shred foes lined up in a row
worldcombat.skill.razorleaf.use.2: Chew on a stationary foe beat after beat
The volley splits into %2$s waves; each wave strikes every enemy in the lane once for about %1$s physical damage, so the same target can be cut wave after wave. It also lands critical hits more often.
Each leaf curtain advances up to %1$s blocks with a %2$s-block lane half-width and %3$s between waves; only what the curtain passes is cut.
The curtain advances at %1$s blocks/tick; the faster it goes, the harder a standing target dodges the later waves.
worldcombat.skill.razorleaf.broad.on: Broad form: the lane widens to 1.8x, each wave is heavier (×1.15) and cooldown is 4 ticks lower, but there is one wave fewer.
worldcombat.skill.razorleaf.broad.off: Dense form (default): one extra wave and 5 ticks more cooldown, but the lane narrows to 0.8x and each wave is lighter.
worldcombat.skill.razorleaf.timing: Range %1$s blocks, wind-up %2$s, recovery %3$s, %4$s PP, cooldown %5$s.
worldcombat.skill.razorleaf.growth.0: From level %1$s each wave rises to %2$s with %3$s waves and %4$s blocks of range.
worldcombat.skill.razorleaf.preference.b: On: the lane widens to 1.8x, each wave is heavier (×1.15) and cooldown is 4 ticks lower, but there is one wave fewer. Off (dense form, default): one extra wave down a lane narrowed to 0.8x, at 5 ticks more cooldown and a lighter wave — shredding a column with a tighter band.
worldcombat.skill.razorleaf.preference.a: Beyond this distance the companion closes in first; larger values open the volley from farther away.
On: when more foes line up along the aim, the volley is preferred to sweep the row. Off: the line is ignored and it ranks as an ordinary ranged leaf throw.
